title: Cazic Thule: Static Mode
summary: Static-mode Cazic Thule combines zone reinforcements, fear and growing physical vulnerability.
overview: Static-mode Cazic Thule combines zone reinforcements, fear and growing physical vulnerability.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Clear the zone before the pull; the initial call can bring surviving enemies to the main target.
Collect the nightmare minions summoned at 70% and 40%.
Prepare for fear casts at 60% and 30%.
Players within 60 units take a scripted terror pulse every forty seconds.
Slashing, two-handed blunt and one-handed piercing attacks gain increased effectiveness at 50%, with a larger vulnerability at 20%.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 255.
Several other health thresholds emit flavor announcements only. Damage guidance follows implemented skill IDs rather than swapped comments for skills 2 and 3.
